name: claude2feishu
description: Claude Code ↔ 飞书双向通信

scripts.service-start: nohup npx tsx src/notifyd.ts > ~/.claude/feishu/notifyd.log 2>&1 & sleep 1 && curl -s http://127.0.0.1:${FEISHU_NOTIFYD_PORT:-9876}/health | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null || echo '(check service-status)'
scripts.service-stop: kill $(cat ~/.claude/feishu/notifyd.pid 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ notifyd stopped' || echo '⚠️  notifyd not running'
scripts.service-status: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:${FEISHU_NOTIFYD_PORT:-9876}/health 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool || echo '❌ notifyd not running'
